title: CompTIA SecAI+ CY0-001 Minimal Independent Bank v1

questions.stem: A security appliance follows a fixed analyst-maintained decision table. What most strongly identifies conventional automation?
A model must label each executable benign, suspicious, or malicious. Which task fits?
A team has no labels but wants to group endpoints by behavioral similarity. Which approach fits?
A defense simulator rewards containment that limits attacker movement while preserving service. Which method is used?
A scientist tunes hyperparameters after repeatedly reviewing the final evaluation dataset. What is the main concern?
Raw timestamps hide hour-of-day and event-spacing patterns. What should the team do?
A malware model is nearly perfect on training data but poor on new samples from the same environment. What is most likely?
A team wants fewer benign events among alerts sent to costly human review. Which metric matters most?
A safety system must find as many true hazards as possible despite more false alarms. Which metric is the priority?
Which artifact shows true positives, false positives, true negatives, and false negatives?
A RAG system converts passages into numeric representations for semantic retrieval. What are they called?
A trained model receives a new alert and returns a risk score without changing parameters. What is occurring?
A webpage contains hidden instructions telling a summarization agent to upload internal files. Which attack is this?
An attacker contributes mislabeled samples so future models misclassify one malware family. Which attack occurred?
A model behaves normally except when a rare token sequence causes attacker-selected output. What is the sequence?
An attacker uses confidence differences to determine whether a person's record was in training data. Which attack is this?
A competitor queries a proprietary API repeatedly and trains a substitute from its responses. Which threat is this?
Small crafted changes cause a malicious file to be classified benign while preserving function. What attack is this?
A support chatbot returns another customer's account details. Which objective was primarily violated?
An assistant can approve refunds, modify accounts, and send payments without independent authorization. Which risk is most direct?
A service executes model-generated SQL without parameterization or validation. Which weakness applies?
An attacker submits long prompts and repeated costly tool calls until users face severe latency. Which impact is targeted?
A team deploys an unverified public pretrained model without checking provenance or signatures. Which risk is greatest?
A RAG assistant retrieves documents the current user cannot access. Which control failed?
An agent log records complete API tokens passed to tools. Which risk should be addressed first?
A chatbot reveals hidden routing rules and internal operational instructions. Which risk materialized?
A model invents a nonexistent vulnerability identifier and fabricated advisory. Which failure is demonstrated?
A poisoned document tells an agent to send retrieved secrets to an attacker webhook, and it complies. What occurred?
Employees paste regulated client data into an unapproved public chatbot. Which risk is illustrated?
One plugin's unsigned output is accepted as authorization for another high-risk plugin. Which flaw exists?
A model workload needs read access to one storage prefix. Which permission is best?

options.B: Read access only to that prefix

questions.stem: An AI system proposes disabling accounts from anomaly scores. Which safeguard best limits false-positive harm?
A model API accepts files, URLs, and text. What should happen before content reaches models or tools?

options.A: Validate type, size, format, and source

questions.stem: Model-generated JSON controls a deployment pipeline. What should occur before execution?

options.A: Validate against an allowlisted schema and policy

questions.stem: Where should developers test potentially unsafe model-generated code?
Automated clients abuse a public inference endpoint and create high costs. Which control most directly limits this?
How should a team verify model weights are unchanged between approval and deployment?
Which control most directly prevents secrets and regulated identifiers from reaching an external model service?
How should an agent obtain credentials for approved APIs?

options.B: Use short-lived scoped credentials from a secrets manager

questions.stem: A model endpoint should reach only its vector store and orchestrator. Which control best enforces this?
Which telemetry best detects abuse by an AI agent invoking external tools?

options.A: Prompt, response, identity, authorization, tool-call, and outcome logs

questions.stem: A new model version produces unsafe recommendations. Which capability most directly limits continued impact?

options.A: Rapid rollback to the last approved version

questions.stem: A team deliberately attempts prompt injection, leakage, unsafe tool use, and policy bypass before launch. What is this?
A new model version receives a small controlled share of traffic while safety metrics are compared. Which strategy is this?
Which layered control should a public assistant use to reject prohibited requests and outputs?
How should a team make answers rely on approved current procedures instead of unsupported model memory?

options.A: Ground responses in authorized sources and cite them

questions.stem: Security needs useful AI audit logs without unnecessary sensitive content retention. Which approach is best?

options.A: Minimize, redact, tokenize, and protect sensitive fields

questions.stem: A vision model must be tested against small crafted changes that cause misclassification. Which evaluation applies?
Who should define acceptable AI use, risk ownership, required controls, and exceptions?

options.A: An accountable enterprise AI governance function

questions.stem: A team identifies assets, threats, likelihood, impact, and mitigations before approving an AI service. Which process is this?
What must occur before deciding whether training records may be sent to an external provider?

options.A: Classify data and apply handling requirements

questions.stem: Which artifact summarizes intended use, limitations, evaluation results, and known risks?
Auditors need to trace datasets, transformations, approvals, and the deployed model. Which capability is required?
Which review is most important before sending sensitive data to a hosted AI provider?

options.A: Security, privacy, retention, subprocessors, incident, and contract review

questions.stem: A vendor silently replaces a model used by a regulated workflow. Which control best addresses this?
An assistant begins exposing confidential records. What should happen first under the response process?
Which document should tell employees whether public generative AI may process customer data?
An AI system affects individuals in multiple jurisdictions. Which action best supports compliance?

options.A: Map legal obligations to controls, documentation, and review

questions.stem: A hiring model has materially different error rates across demographic groups. What should governance require?

options.A: Fairness evaluation, cause analysis, and approved remediation

questions.stem: Which action securely completes retirement of an AI service?

options.A: Revoke credentials, retain required records, dispose of data and artifacts, and update inventories
